response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), h AS (SELECT Name, avg_price, avg_bpms, AVG(avg_bpms) OVER () AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT Name, avg_price, avg_bpms, avg_bpms / overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM h WHERE overall_avg IS NOT NULL
